<function name="SetBackgroundColor" parent="DPanel" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets the background color of the panel.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="color" type="Color">The background <page>Color</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Creates two empty panels with their background colors set to red and blue team colors.</description>
	<code>
local COLOR_TEAM_RED = Color(255, 64, 64, 255)
local COLOR_TEAM_BLUE = Color(153, 204, 255, 255)

BGPanel1 = vgui.Create("DPanel")
BGPanel1:SetPos(20, 20)
BGPanel1:SetSize(200, 200)
BGPanel1:SetBackgroundColor(COLOR_TEAM_RED)

BGPanel2 = vgui.Create("DPanel")
BGPanel2:SetPos(220, 20)
BGPanel2:SetSize(200, 200)
BGPanel2:SetBackgroundColor(COLOR_TEAM_BLUE)
	</code>
	<output><image src="DPanel_SetBackgroundColor_example1.png"/></output>

</example>
